title: How Physical Therapists Can Prevent Future Health Problems
titleZh: 物理治疗师如何预防未来的健康问题
credits: Stephen Wade reported on this story for the Associated Press. John Russell adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: Many of us might only seek out physical therapists if we are recovering from accidental injuries or surgery.
sentences.zh: 我们中的许多人可能只有在从意外受伤或手术中恢复时才会去找物理治疗师。

sentences.en: However, medical experts say these specialists can also help prevent many health problems if they are seen on a regular basis.
sentences.zh: 然而，医学专家表示，如果定期就诊，这些专家还能帮助预防许多健康问题。

sentences.en: One leader in the industry, Sharon Dunn, even calls physical therapists “the best-kept secret in health care.”
sentences.zh: 行业领袖之一莎伦·邓恩甚至将物理治疗师称为“医疗保健领域最被忽视的宝藏”。

sentences.en: Dunn is the past president of the American Physical Therapy Association (APTA).
sentences.zh: 邓恩曾任美国物理治疗协会（APTA）主席。

sentences.en: She recently told The Associated Press she thinks people need to look at physical therapists in a new way – as health practitioners who can help identify possible medical issues before they appear.
sentences.zh: 她最近告诉美联社，她认为人们需要以全新的眼光看待物理治疗师——把他们看作能在问题显现之前帮助识别潜在健康隐患的医疗从业者。

sentences.en: Other health experts share this opinion.
sentences.zh: 其他医学专家也持有这一观点。

sentences.en: They include Roger Herr, the current president of the APTA, and Gammon Earhart of Washington University in St. Louis.
sentences.zh: 他们包括现任美国物理治疗协会主席罗格·赫尔，以及圣路易斯华盛顿大学的加门·厄哈特。

sentences.en: They both shared Dunn’s prevention message in separate discussions with the AP.
sentences.zh: 他们分别在接受美联社单独采访时分享了邓恩关于预防的理念。

sentences.en: Earhart urges people to think about physical therapists just as they do dentists.
sentences.zh: 厄哈特敦促人们像对待牙医一样看待物理治疗师。

sentences.en: “Even if you’re not having any problem, you go in and have everything checked out.”
sentences.zh: 即使你目前没有任何问题，也会进去接受全面检查。

sentences.en: She noted that such examinations could help find and deal with problems early.
sentences.zh: 她指出，这类检查有助于及早发现并处理问题。

sentences.en: For example, an exam could include a patient’s health history and current health – things like physical activity, sleep, nutrition, and so on.
sentences.zh: 例如，检查可能包括患者的病史和当前健康状况——如身体活动、睡眠、营养等等。

sentences.en: This could be followed by a look at how a person is moving.
sentences.zh: 随后可能会观察一个人的活动方式。

sentences.en: Exams might uncover things like postural issues or unusual body movements.
sentences.zh: 检查可能揭示出姿势问题或不寻常的身体动作等问题。

sentences.en: Herr is a big supporter of yearly wellness visits.
sentences.zh: 赫尔是年度健康检查的坚定支持者。

sentences.en: He told the AP he believes physical therapists can be helpful for all kinds of people – the young, athletes, or anyone who wants to be as “independent as possible.”
sentences.zh: 他告诉美联社，他相信物理治疗师对各类人群都有帮助——无论是年轻人、运动员，还是任何希望尽可能保持“独立”的人。

sentences.en: In the United States, you can now visit a physical therapist in all 50 states without needing permission from a doctor or surgeon.
sentences.zh: 在美国，你现在可以在全部50个州无需医生或外科医生许可就直接就诊物理治疗师。

sentences.en: However, a yearly exam might not be covered by a person’s health insurance.
sentences.zh: 然而，年度检查可能不在个人医疗保险的覆盖范围内。

sentences.en: This could prevent some from seeking out care.
sentences.zh: 这可能阻止一些人寻求治疗。

sentences.en: Earhart estimated such a visit in areas across the U.S. Midwest might cost around $150.
sentences.zh: 厄哈特估计，在美国中西部地区，这类就诊费用可能约为150美元。

sentences.en: Herr suggested a cost of $200-$300 in more costly areas.
sentences.zh: 赫尔建议在花费较高的地区，成本约为200至300美元。

sentences.en: But both experts said that in the long run, such exams might save money and can add healthy years.
sentences.zh: 但两位专家都表示，从长远来看，这类检查或许能够节省开支，并能为人们增添健康的岁月。

sentences.en: “I think if people understood more that the way they move might be setting them up for a problem down the line, they’d be much more inclined to see a physical therapist,” Earhart said.
sentences.zh: 伊哈特说：'我认为，如果人们更清楚地意识到自己的活动方式可能会给自己日后埋下隐患，他们就会更加倾向于去看物理治疗师。'

sentences.en: We are all built differently.
sentences.zh: 每个人的身体构造都各不相同。

sentences.en: So, it might be useful to examine children early to see what sports or activities might be good for them.
sentences.zh: 因此，尽早对儿童进行检查，看看哪些运动或活动对他们有益，或许会有帮助。

sentences.en: Physical therapists can carry out such early exams.
sentences.zh: 物理治疗师可以开展这样早期的检查。

sentences.en: Earhart said, “If we screened kids as they were choosing sports and said this sport is probably not the right kind of stress for the way you are put together, it could save a lot pain and problems down the line.”
sentences.zh: 伊哈特说：'如果我们能在孩子们选择运动时就对他们进行筛查，并告诉他们这项运动可能并不适合他们的身体构造，所施加的压力未必恰当，那或许能省去日后大量的痛苦和问题。'

sentences.en: She added about children, “Maybe they don’t have the hips for ballet.”
sentences.zh: 她就儿童补充道：'也许他们并不具备跳芭蕾所需的髋部条件。'

sentences.en: Distance runners could also think this way.
sentences.zh: 长跑运动员也可以这样考虑。

sentences.en: Some are built to avoid injuries despite running many kilometers while others are not.
sentences.zh: 有些人天生即使奔跑数千公里也不易受伤，而另一些人则不然。

sentences.en: Exams by physical therapists could help identify future problems.
sentences.zh: 物理治疗师进行的检查有助于识别未来的问题。

sentences.en: Another area where physical therapists can help is with fall prevention.
sentences.zh: 物理治疗师能够提供帮助的另一领域是预防跌倒。

sentences.en: Falling – and the fear of falling – can be major issues, especially for the aging population.
sentences.zh: 跌倒——以及对跌倒的恐惧——可能是严重的问题，尤其对老年人群体而言。

sentences.en: “You want to show people they can get back up if they fall,” Herr said.
sentences.zh: 赫尔说：'你要向人们表明，他们跌倒之后是可以重新站起来的。'

sentences.en: “And once they know they can do it, it gives them confidence and it can help reduce the fear of falling."
sentences.zh: '而且一旦他们知道自己能够做到，就会增强信心，也有助于减轻对跌倒的恐惧。'

sentences.en: He added, “One of the risks of falling is that people don’t do anything, so you don’t move and therefore you become more out of shape...”
sentences.zh: 他补充道：'跌倒的一个风险在于，人们会因此什么都不做，于是不再活动，于是身体状况就会越来越差……'

sentences.en: Herr said one example could be to introduce exercises involving “floor to stand” movements.
sentences.zh: 赫尔举了这样一个例子，即引入涉及'从地面躺姿起身站立'的动作练习。

sentences.en: These can help improve flexibility, strength, balance, coordination, and planning.
sentences.zh: 这些练习有助于提升灵活性、力量、平衡感、协调性以及规划能力。

sentences.en: “It sounds simple getting up from a lying position on the floor to stand,” Herr said.
sentences.zh: 赫尔说：'从躺在地面上的姿势起身站立，听起来很简单。'

sentences.en: “But it’s a great exercise for all age groups.”
sentences.zh: 但对各个年龄段的人来说，这都是极好的锻炼。

sentences.en: Earhart estimated about half of physical therapy patients seek help to deal with issues related to being overweight.
sentences.zh: 哈特估计，大约一半的物理治疗患者寻求帮助是为了解决与超重相关的问题。

sentences.en: “The more weight somebody is carrying the higher the loads are on their joints,” she said.
sentences.zh: "一个人携带的体重越多，他们关节所承受的压力就越大，"她说。

sentences.en: Herr said he had watched extremely overweight patients successfully lose large amounts of weight.
sentences.zh: 赫尔说他见过极度肥胖的患者成功地减掉了大量体重。

sentences.en: He noted that some of these individuals are motivated for a specific reason.
sentences.zh: 他指出，其中一些人出于特定原因而受到激励。

sentences.en: But for others, it is not always that clear and easy.
sentences.zh: 但对其他人来说，情况并不总是那么清晰和容易。

sentences.en: “I have seen people change based on a milestone, like having a kid and they really want to be a good parent,” Herr said.
sentences.zh: “我见过有人因为某个里程碑式的经历而改变，比如有了孩子之后，他们真的想成为一名好父母，”赫尔说道。

sentences.en: “They want to be a fit parent, and the same thing with a grandparent.
sentences.zh: “他们想成为一名健康的父母，祖父母也一样。

sentences.en: So that motivates people to engage because of a lifestyle change.”
sentences.zh: 所以生活方式的改变会激励人们参与其中。”

sentences.en: I’m John Russell.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·拉塞尔。

sentences.en: And I’m Jill Robbins.
sentences.zh: 我是吉尔·罗宾斯。
